blurb: Chatfield State Park offers year-round outdoor activities including boating, water skiing, hiking, biking, horseback riding, and camping with 197 campsites. The park features 32.8 miles of trails and diverse wildlife habitats. Group picnic areas and event spaces are available for gatherings and events.
